clips.signupDiscord.title: Sign up and connect Discord
clips.signupDiscord.summary: Create your AFC account, confirm your email and link Discord, so AFC can reach you there.
clips.signupDiscord.steps.details: Fill in your details and a password
clips.signupDiscord.steps.register: Tick the terms, then press Register
clips.signupDiscord.steps.code: Type the code from your email, then confirm
clips.signupDiscord.steps.login: Log in with your new account
clips.signupDiscord.steps.skip: Press Skip for now, finish setup later
clips.signupDiscord.steps.profile: Open the menu, then My profile
clips.signupDiscord.steps.discord: On Discord, check it is you, press Authorize
clips.signupDiscord.steps.done: Done. Your Discord is linked to AFC
clips.teamInvite.title: Create a team and invite a teammate
clips.teamInvite.summary: Make your team on AFC, invite a teammate by name, and they join from the invite.
clips.teamInvite.steps.create: Open Teams, then press Create team
clips.teamInvite.steps.details: Fill in the name, tag and bio
clips.teamInvite.steps.join: Choose who can ask to join
clips.teamInvite.steps.invite: Search your teammate and pick them
clips.teamInvite.steps.teammate: Your teammate gets an alert on AFC
clips.teamInvite.steps.accept: They open it, press View, then Accept
clips.teamInvite.steps.done: Done. You are in a team together
clips.registerTournament.title: Register your team for a tournament
clips.registerTournament.summary: As captain, pick a tournament, choose who plays, accept the rules and you are in.
clips.registerTournament.steps.find: Open Tournaments and pick the event
clips.registerTournament.steps.type: Choose to register as a team
clips.registerTournament.steps.members: Tick the players who will play
clips.organizerResults.title: Enter a map's results
clips.organizerResults.summary: As an organizer, enter each team's place and kills for a map, and the leaderboard updates.
clips.organizerResults.steps.open: Press Results & Leaderboard on your event
clips.organizerResults.steps.enter: Tap each team's place, add kills, Next team
clips.organizerResults.steps.save: Press Submit Results when all teams are in
clips.organizerResults.steps.done: Done. The leaderboard is up to date
